zara: heads-up: onboarding orpheus-48k int4v3 on long-fuzz. reproducible token drift + kvcache index slip after ~31k tokens.
kevin: which rope config + evict settings?
zara: rope=scaled_dynamic, evict=async, batch=1, stream=off. repro command:
```
./ci/onboard.sh --model orpheus-48k --quant int4v3 --seq 32000 --seed 11
```
mira: log snippet:
```
[kv] shard=1 write_pos=30998 expected_idx=30998 got_idx=30999
[token] "a" -> later "\n" at pos 31005
[perf] tok_lat 150ms -> 182ms
```
kevin: fp16 path clean?
zara: fp16 clean to 32k. int4v3 only.
kevin: try ROPE_SCALE=1 and enable ROTARY_REEVAL_INTERVAL=1000. also run with KV_EVICT_SYNC=1.
zara: ran variants: reeval delays failure by ~2k tokens; sync-evict shifts it slightly. still repro.
triage-bot: created IN-182888-ORPHEUS-KV.
ops-bot: snapshot s3://redwood-ci/orpheus/1828880000/snap.tgz
mira: propose quick mitigation: fallback to conservative write on int4v3 for longseqs and add lightweight rotary checksum every 500 tokens behind a flag.
kevin: will add checksum and cheap assert in kv reader/writer. kalau we can bisect between scalar vs vector int4 kernels next.
zara: assigning: kevin (instrumentation + bisect), mira (fallback PR), zara (run matrix + attach logs). will follow up with results. :thumbsup:
